headline: Stonecradle, Linn Mercy Lead Late Night Exchanges
war_summary: Late wires to the 03:15 edition put Stonecradle and Linn Mercy back at the head of the sheet after the midnight quiet, with five changes in two hours about The Reach, Buckler Sound and The Heir's Knife leaving that district at two Warden, six Colonial and one unheld amid 9,806 Colonial and 14,755 Warden casualties in the day, while Linn Mercy logged two changes to the same hour about Rotdust and Lathair among twenty-two day affairs to stand eleven Colonial to none. Farranac Coast shows three changes in two hours about Transient Valley and The Bone Haft to 01:57 for two Warden to nine Colonial, and Fisherman's Row two about Fort Ember to 01:33 to stand nine Colonial to none despite scant casualties. Gutter's five affairs about The Parras to 01:15 now show seven Warden to none, and the Weathered Expanse three in six hours about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to 01:15 for six Warden to three Colonial with 11,309 and 12,095 day losses. Callahan's Passage, Nevish Line and Marban Hollow report heavy lists with no fresh flips.
